messages:
Samir (CS): Quick sync — Acme onboarding: they asked for a one-pager on SLA acceptance and what triggers uptime/latency credits. I uploaded the enablement pack draft: https://redwood.app/sheets/acme-sla-pack :wave
Ben (Customer Success): Thanks. Two quick Qs — is this for hosted API or Dedicated? credit calc differs a lot.
Samir (CS): Hosted for now, might move to Dedicated in Q3. We need to confirm: uptime SLA 99.95% over billing month, and latency target P95 < 200ms for embeddings route. Is that still realistic?
Aisha (Eng): For typical traffic profile yes, but depends on sequence length and batching. We should prefill prefix cache and warm up their main model. I can run a warmup job during onboarding window.
Maria C (SE): Agree — warmup + prefix caching will get P95 under control. I attached a small warmup script in the pack. Example:
```bash
# warmup script snippet
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"input": "sample embedding warmup"}' \n    https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings
done
```
Samir (CS): Nice. Customer asked how credits would be calculated if we miss the SLA. We normally prorate by outage seconds against the monthly uptime window and cap at 100% of the monthly invoice for the affected service. Want me to pull an example calc for their expected spend?
Ben (Customer Success): Please. Also they want a simple explainer for product folks — e.g., what constitutes a latency breach (P95 > target for > 15m window?) and whether transient spikes count.
Aisha (Eng): Operational definition we use: a latency incident is when measured P95 across the customer’s routes exceeds the target for three consecutive 5-minute windows (so ~15m). Shorter blips under a single 5-minute window don't trigger credits. That should be in the pack.
Maria C (SE): Add a short diag flow in the doc: measurement -> validation (exclude client-side overhead) -> rollout window -> credit calc example. Also include warmup recommended schedule: post-deploy warmup for 60m, then monitoring for 72h.
deploy-bot: Deployment started by @aisha on branch feat/acme-warmup at 2024-08-18T16:22:10Z :rocket:
Samir (CS): Action items: 1) Aisha to confirm warmup job runbook and estimate (ETA EOD tomorrow). 2) Maria to insert the diag flow + one credit example (ETA 24h). 3) Ben and I to produce the customer-facing one-pager and Q&A (ETA 48h). 4) Ops to confirm monitoring threshold config and alerting channel.
Ben (Customer Success): I'll prep the one-pager template and schedule a dry-run with Enablement. Also flagging renewal risk: if we can't lock acceptance within 2 weeks, mark as "medium" risk and escalate to AMs.
Aisha (Eng): Will confirm runbook and post the warmup cronjob config here when ready.
Samir (CS): Thanks team. I'll send the draft to Acme once the pack has the warmup snippet and the credit calc example. :thumbsup:
